_Generated 2026-07-22 by /mol:map (refreshed after the backend-mirror chain 01–06)._

## Inventory

Catalog of `include/atomiverse/` after the **backend-mirror** restructure
(branch `backend-mirror`). Top level: `core/` + `cpu/` + `cuda/` + `torch/`
(experimental) + `molrs.hpp`. **No `facade/`, no top-level `longrange/` or
`potentials/`.** Directory names are full English words, mirrored across `cpu/`
and `cuda/`. No backward compatibility anywhere.

---

### `core/` — CUDA-free contracts

- Precision tiers (`StorageReal`/`WorkReal`/`AccReal`; `LocalInt`/`TagInt`/`ImageInt`/`BigInt`), `Mat3`/`Vec3`, units, Frame schema keys, device tags, `backend_traits`.
- The device-independent **Driver dispatch template** `Driver<PhaseEnum, DeviceTag>` (+ impl) and the contracts relocated from the old contract layer: `plan.h`, `stage.h`, `role.h` (ex-component_role), `verdict.h` (ex-loop), `iteration_status.h`, `molrs_contract.h`, `driver_template.h`/`driver_template_impl.h`.
- Extras: `gto.h`, `real_harmonics.h`, `pair_list.h`, `binding.h`, `report.h`, `system_scalars.h`, `log.h`, `timer.h`.
- `molrs.hpp` — stable CXX FFI header.

Namespaces are **not yet** aligned to directories (`ATV::cpu::md::MD` under `cpu/dynamics/`, `md::Phase` unchanged) — a deliberate follow-up.

---

### `cpu/` backend

- **Pillars:** `frame/` (`cpu::Frame` = blocks+meta+simbox, `cpu::Box`, materialize/write_back/transfer), `driver/`, `component/`.
- **Driver (`driver/`):** loop node `cpu::Driver<P>`, erased nestable base `cpu::DriverNode`, the **`cpu::Runtime`** coordinator composing the three sub-runtimes, `Criterion`/`criteria.h` (`ForceConverged`, `StopOnNaN`), `OutcomePolicy`, `SubDriver`, step executor, `backend_traits`.
- **Dissolved runtime sub-parts:** `communication/` (`DomainRuntime` — domain decomposition, halo, migration, reduce, gather, rcb, bcast), `device/` (`DeviceRuntime` — OpenMP threads + `TimerRegistry`), `asynchronous/` (`AnalysisRuntime` — snapshot ring, executors).
- **Infra:** `neighbor/` (`NeighborList`, `CellList`, `PairList`), `linalg/`, `replica/`, `task/`.
- **Domains:** `evaluate/` (Evaluate preset + single_point), `dynamics/` (MD: VelocityVerlet, NoseHoover(NPT), FixLangevin/Csvr/Rattle, Barostat, Deform, InitVelocity), `montecarlo/` (MC/NptMc/Gcmc + movers), `minimize/` (LBFGS/CG + recorders), `path/` (NEB + PathDriver + remd), `vibration/` (Hessian + thermochem), `scf/` (RHF/UHF/RKS/UKS/ROHF/GHF + integrals/gradient/xc + **debt** SCFSolver/SCFConfig), `semiempirical/` (AM1/RM1/NDDO; **debt** `nddo_system.h`), `planewave/` (PWSolver/PWEvaluator), `gpw/`, `xc/` (Padé LDA), `longrange/` (Ewald/PME/PPPM components + absorbed operator math ewald_sum/pme_influence/pme_spline/pppm_green/fmm_*/gaussian_extent), `potentials/` (PairLJCut, PairMorse, CoulLong, bonded styles, EAM, SW), `bias/`, `observe/` (RDF/MSD/VACF/VirialStress/Mulliken/…), `record/` (Thermo/Xyz/Cube/…).
- **I/O (`io/`, CPU only):** extxyz, frame_writer, lammps_data, forcefield.

### `cuda/` backend (mirrors cpu; see debt note)

Pillars `frame/`, `driver/`, `component/`, `device/`. Infra `communication/`, `neighbor/`, `asynchronous/`. Domains `evaluate/`, `dynamics/`, `minimize/`, `planewave/`, `scf/`, `longrange/` (reciprocal-space; renamed from the old kspace path), `potentials/` (incl. the `__host__ __device__` pair kernel), `observe/`, `record/`. Loop node `cuda::Driver<P>`; termination via `Criterion`/`add_criterion` (no LoopHandler). **Debt:** the CUDA backend does not compile on `dev` (pre-existing rot — stale Frame::atoms/Real/units constants; see `notes.md` [2026-07-22]); its directory structure is mirrored but its code is resurrected separately.

### `torch/` backend (experimental)

`frame/` (tensor-backed autograd Frame), `component/`, `device/`, `neighbor/`, `potentials/` (LJ/HarmonicBond skeleton).

---

### Architecture gates (`tests/architecture/*.sh`, run under ctest)

`no_facade` · `no_toplevel_shared_math` (+ no cuda/kspace) · `path_words` (full-word mirrored dirs) · `driver_names` (Driver/DriverNode; no CPUDriver/CUDADriver/LoopHandler; Criterion) · `no_backend` (dissolved runtime) · `layout_mirror` (no runtime/loop/shared dirs; cuda ⊆ cpu; tests mirror source) · `docs_vocab` (CLAUDE/AGENTS free of legacy vocabulary). Plus reused `no_factory_scrub` and `core/stage_typing_scrub`. Every backend-mirror feature also ships one `regressions/layout/<case>/` out-of-library consumer.
